summary: Comprehensive gap analysis of the system against all 7 challenge requirements. Identifies 5 gaps that need fixing: (1) Follow-up automation is weak - no actual reminder scheduling, (2) Booking receipt is missing, (3) Agentic workflow traceable logs need better UI, (4) Reasoning page doesn't show enough decision explanation, (5) Completion confirmation flow is missing. Proposes specific file changes to close every gap.
